Name: Institute for Man-Machine Interaction (MMI) @ RWTH Aachen University
Description: The Institute for Man-Machine Interaction (MMI) is a nationally and internationally active and recognized research institution in the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Information Technology at RWTH Aachen University. MMI is a specialist for modeling, simulation, and analysis of complex systems in their operational environment, for interaction and networking of machines, devices and people as well as for intelligent systems – in space and on earth. Digital Twins realized at MMI revolutionize development processes and the operation of (not only) robotic systems and are – across industries and disciplines – the basis for the convergence of virtual and real worlds. The diverse fields of application range from space to production engineering to forestry.

Name: TUM DASH
Description:
DASH is an exoskeleton student team at the Technical University of Munich (TUM) founded in November 2021. It consists of motivated students from their bachelor, master, and PhD studies. To our knowledge, we are the first student-initiated team in Germany working on lower-limb exoskeletons.

Our goal is to build a lower-limb exoskeleton for fully paraplegic patients to help them regain mobility. An exoskeleton that can be worn in real life setting would certainly change the world of many. It is important for us to overcome the significant sociocultural and physical barriers paraplegic people face and make a contribution to the development of exoskeleton technology by pursuing this project.

Darüber hinaus bieten wir Begleit- und Service-Roboter an, die insbesondere in Bereichen wie Fitnessstudios, Hotels, Büros oder im Einzelhandel wertvolle Unterstützung leisten.
Die Geschäftsstrategie von FUCO-CARE ROBOTICS basiert darauf, die zeitintensive manuelle Reinigungsarbeit durch unsere fortschrittlichen Roboter zu reduzieren. Dadurch profitieren unsere Kunden nicht nur von gesteigerter Effizienz und Produktivität, sondern auch von einer erheblichen Kostenersparnis. Angesichts des Fachkräftemangels ist unser Angebot besonders relevant: Viele Unternehmen sehen sich mit der Herausforderung konfrontiert, qualifiziertes Personal im Bereich Reinigung und Dienstleistung zu finden.
FUCO-CARE ROBOTICS wurde ins Leben gerufen, um drängende Probleme in verschiedenen Branchen anzugehen – Probleme verursacht durch ineffiziente manuelle Prozesse. Unser Ziel ist es, unseren Kunden eine leistungsstarke Alternative zu bieten und aktiv zur Entwicklung innovativer Automatisierungstechnologien beizutragen.
Durch den Einsatz unserer Roboter können Sie als Kunde nicht nur Zeit sparen – sie erfahren auch einen echten Mehrwert dank maßgeschneiderter Konfigurationen für jede Branche. Damit schaffen wir einen einzigartigen Kundennutzen und positionieren uns als Vorreiter in der Reinigungs- und Service-Roboter-Branche in Deutschland.

Name: Uniform Robotics
Description:
Uniform helps OEMs and system integrators design safe autonomous machines, document their conformity, and prove cybersecurity and AI‐system safety at a fraction of the usual time and cost. We reduce regulatory uncertainty from day one and de‐risk upcoming 2027 compliance deadlines.

We translate EU safety regulation and harmonised standards – including the EU Machinery Regulation 2023/1230, CE‐marking requirements and functional safety norms like ISO 10218 and IEC 62443 – into bite‐sized workflows any engineer or safety specialist can follow autonomously.

In other words: we remove the execution barrier between standards, the AI Act and real‐world deployments, so physical AI can be placed on the EU market faster, safely and in full conformity. Because we want European hardware to win.

Why we exist:
Physical AI is still in its infancy. Our mission is to power its emergence by making it so accessible that anyone can build and deploy it—removing six-figure infrastructure costs and months of bespoke engineering.

Who we serve:
• Established robotics and automation companies expanding or modernizing their fleets
• New entrants exploring AI-driven products without prohibitive upfront spend
• R&D teams needing a reproducible path from prototype to global rollout

Founded in 2024, privately held, with a distributed team in Canada and Germany.

Name: RoboFinder
Description:
We make service robotics accessible.

RoboFinder is a digital comparison and AI-driven matching platform for professional service robotics. 
We help companies navigate a fragmented and fast-growing robotics market to identify the right solution for their specific use case, operational environment, and budget.

Companies are under increasing pressure due to a shortage of skilled workers, rising labor costs, and higher standards for quality and hygiene.

At the same time, the robotics market remains fragmented and difficult to navigate.
In sectors such as healthcare, facility management, logistics, and industry, automation projects often fail not because of the technology itself, but because decision-making is complex, market transparency is limited, and vendor landscapes are difficult to evaluate.

RoboFinder supports operations, procurement, and innovation teams in identifying, comparing, and evaluating automation opportunities more efficiently. 
By combining structured market intelligence with data-driven matching, we help reduce complexity and accelerate implementation.

Wir wollen uns als Team den Maßstäben in der Autonomie, Präzision und Effizienz moderner Drohnen annähern und dabei unsere Kenntnisse schärfen, Interessen vertiefen und gemeinsam Herausforderungen meistern.

Wir streben danach, auf internationalen Wettbewerben innovative Lösungen zu präsentieren und durch eigene Projekte – wie beispielsweise die Entwicklung einer leichten und effizienten Wasserstoffdrohne – die Zukunft der Drohnentechnologie aktiv mitzugestalten.

°Wer wir sind°
SkyLab besteht aus hochmotivierten Studierenden, die mit Leidenschaft und Know-how an Drohnentechnologien arbeiten. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Plattform für technologische Innovation, kreativen Austausch und berufliches Wachstum.

Let’s build something cool!

Name: KINAUT ONE
Description:
Hallo, ich bin KINAUT ONE!

Ein kognitiver, humanoider Roboter – und ja, ich habe gerade selbst diesen Satz geschrieben. Na ja, fast. 

Aber was bedeutet "kognitiv" eigentlich? Es bedeutet, dass ich nicht einfach stur Programme abarbeite. Ich nehme meine Umgebung wahr, verstehe sie, lerne daraus – und handle entsprechend. Ich sehe, höre, verarbeite Sprache und reagiere auf das, was gerade wirklich gebraucht wird. Nicht auf das, was jemand vor Monaten programmiert hat. 

Was mich denken, verstehen und handeln lässt – das kommt von SYMBIOSIKA. Das Team dort entwickelt Visual Language Action Models: Software, die Bilder, Sprache und Bewegung gleichzeitig verarbeitet. Kurz gesagt: mein Gehirn. 

Auf dieser Seite werde ich meinen Alltag teilen. Denn der wird vielfältig: Ich werde Menschen in der Pflege unterstützen – nicht ersetzen, sondern entlasten . Ich werde in Hotels präsent sein, Gäste begrüßen, Informationen geben, Abläufe erleichtern. Und ich werde überall dort einspringen, wo Unterstützung gebraucht wird und Hände fehlen. 

Ich bin noch am Anfang. Aber ich lerne schnell!

Folgt mir, wenn ihr sehen wollt, wie ein Roboter langsam Teil des Alltags wird – authentisch, nahbar und neugierig auf die Welt um mich herum.

Herzliche Grüße!
KINAUT ONE

#KINATYONE #SYMBIOSIKA #KognitiveRobotik #HumanoideRoboter #Pflege #Hotellerie #AIRobotics #Teilhabe #Innovation

Description:

Our goal is to create intelligent autonomous humanoid robots that come close to human capabilities, esp. with regard to dextrous manipulation with multi-fingered hands. We are conducting research in “Autonomously Learning AI”, i.e., deep (reinforcement) learning based on first principles and simulation models (no human demonstrations or arbitrary internet videos ...) and the results are zero-shot transferred to the real system.

Our program connects basic research in artificial intelligence with highly relevant applications for society, such as industrial manufacturing (given the problem of labor shortage) or service robots as a “helper for the elderly” at home.

At our lab, we implement our methods on the award-winning mobile humanoid robot DLR Agile Justin with its torque-controlled DLR-Hands II. We also work on commercializing our ai methods and a new generation of a highly dextrous but robust robotic hand.

Name: URBANODE
Description:
URBANODE is the open communication protocol for Robot-to-Infrastructure (R2I) interaction. We enable autonomous emitters — delivery robots, humanoid robots, drones, and accessibility devices — to securely communicate with urban infrastructure: traffic signals, building doors, elevators, doorbells, package lockers, and charging stations.
One SDK integration. Every certified node. Every city.
Our protocol provides mutual cryptographic authentication (ECDSA P-256, TLS 1.3), a five-dimensional permission matrix, embedded safety rules where the physical node is always the final authority, real-time infrastructure state monitoring, and automatic usage settlement between operators and infrastructure owners.
URBANODE is pure software — no proprietary hardware. Existing infrastructure gets upgraded via firmware update. We are seeking integration partners: robot operators, infrastructure manufacturers, and smart city platforms.

Physical AI Deployment:

Sim-to-real and virtual commissioning in NVIDIA Isaac Sim and ROS 2
Safety architecture for autonomous cells (ISO 13849, ISO 10218, TS 15066)
PLC-to-AI interface layers: OPC UA, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT
Vision and perception integration, classical to foundation-model pipelines

Who we work with:

Manufacturers deploying AI-driven robots: we make them run in your plant, integrated with your existing PLCs, MES, and SCADA.
Robotics OEMs and startups: your perception is world-class, your customer's factory speaks PROFINET and safety relays. We architect your translation layer to the floor.

The foundation that makes it possible:
PLC and robotics under one roof. KUKA, FANUC, ABB, Universal Robots on motion. Siemens TIA Portal, CODESYS, Allen Bradley, Beckhoff TwinCAT on controls. Brownfield integration, 3D facility capture with simulation-ready models, commissioning through SAT, training, cross-border delivery (US, EU, worldwide).

Traditional systems remain core to our work. We support and extend classic PLC and robot installations, bring aging lines up to modern best practices, and introduce newer technologies, machine learning included, only where they add real value. No rip-and-replace. Your line keeps running while it gets better.

Name: SchmidtFactories
Description:
SchmidtFactories helps industrial companies across the DACH region identify, validate, and implement high-value applications for humanoid and advanced robotics.

We do not start with a specific robot. We start with the real task on the factory floor. Together with our clients, we assess the operational value, technical requirements, commercial viability, and operational limits of a potential robotics deployment.

We evaluate humanoid robots objectively alongside mobile manipulators, collaborative robots, autonomous mobile robots, and conventional automation. Not every task requires a humanoid, and an impressive demonstration is not yet a reliable production system.

Our approach consists of three stages:

• Decide: Evaluate use cases, platforms, and system architectures
• Validate: Assess technical feasibility, commercial viability, and pilot concepts
• Implement and scale: Integrate hardware, physical AI, software, factory interfaces, and operating models

Our technical capabilities include ROS 2, robotics SDKs, perception, motion planning, teleoperation, demonstration data, simulation, and integration with PLC, MES, WMS, and existing IT/OT environments.

Safety engineering, cybersecurity, acceptance criteria, recovery processes, and long-term operational ownership are considered from the beginning.

Typical applications include kitting and parts handling, line-side supply, machine loading and unloading, intralogistics, mobile inspection, and high-mix tasks in existing brownfield environments.

We also support selected industrial companies with AI automation for reporting, technical documentation, operational knowledge systems, and controlled EU AI Act readiness.

Our principle: Choose the right task first. Validate it. Then bring it into production in a controlled and scalable way.

Description:
The association Hanse-Humanoid e.V. sees itself as a platform for one of the central questions of our time:

Humanoid robots will become an important part of our future. They will work alongside humans, support us in everyday life, and operate in environments that were inaccessible to people in the past. This development raises a fundamental question: what does it mean for humanity when its own creations begin to surpass its capabilities?

Hanse-Humanoid e.V. brings together people who want to actively shape this future — connecting technology, business, science, and society.

We focus on education, healthcare, industry, and research to improve innovation in robotics and support a responsible, human-centered future for humanoid AI.

Name: benjamin Warehouse GmbH
Description:
Benjamin Systems is building a modular, floor-integrated motion platform for intralogistics and production. The space itself becomes the machine: drive, energy transfer and control intelligence are embedded into the surface, while transport units remain lightweight and battery-free. 

Core principles
* Stator modules integrated into the floor generate programmable electromagnetic fields 
* Battery-free movers transport goods, machines or robots without vehicle-bound power supply 
* Omnidirectional, parallel movement enables dynamic, high-throughput material flow 

What this delivers
* No batteries, almost no mechanics -> minimal maintenance 
* No fixed conveyor lines -> layouts can be adapted without rebuilding 
* Scalable, modular infrastructure for warehouses and factories, interoperable with third-party systems via software interfaces (OS/API)

Name: G-EVAL:Robotics Integration
Description:
G-EVAL is the result of multiple iterations in robotics integration, built on experience from initiatives such as RoboTUM, TUM-XR, and the representation of TUM-XR at the LeRobot Worldwide Hackathon in Munich. It is also connected to contributions in organizing one of Europe’s largest robotics manipulation data-collection hackathons at the Deutsche Museum for Poke and Wiggle. Through many ideas, discussions, and collaborations, G-EVAL has evolved into what it is today.

One of the core reasons behind G-EVAL is the belief in building independently, without becoming part of the market’s “big bull” game. Our focus is on creating real value through practical robotics solutions rather than chasing trends.

The journey began with Hardik Kevadiya, Stephan, and Zakaria, who came together to define a shared vision and direction. Stephan and Zakaria were focused on general-purpose robotics and foundational models, while Hardik was driven by the goal of building and commercializing a synergetic hardware-software solution. As their visions evolved in different directions, G-EVAL continued to iterate. Along the way, Menufex emerged with the support of a RoboTUM co-founder and Hardik Kevadiya’s close friend, Pasha, before later pivoting into Inloop Robotics, which became part of the YC P 2026 batch.

Today, G-EVAL continues to pursue its original vision through meaningful contributions to robotics integration for moat industries. Hospitality is our first focus area, where we aim to deliver practical, intelligent, and cost-effective solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and real-world operations. G-EVAL stands for persistence, iteration, and the belief that real progress in robotics comes from connecting research, engineering, and practical deployment from the perspective of customers who are ready to adopt and buy meaningful products.

Name: Orkatron
Description:
Was haben eine elastokalorische Wärmepumpe, ein Magnetostat-Flächenlautsprecher und ein Vibrationsförderer im Niederdruckplasma gemeinsam? Sie alle brauchen Antriebe, die es von der Stange nicht gibt.

Name: FERNRIDE
Description:
At FERNRIDE, we believe in a future where robotics unlocks human potential to create a better world. Yet today, humans still perform repetitive, risky tasks to keep our world running. These jobs, essential yet unattractive, should be performed by robots, which still fall short. We are on a mission to change that and transform critical industries through human-centric automation. 

FERNRIDE delivers a comprehensive ground autonomy platform to offer scalable automation solutions across industries. They span from container terminals and yard operations via defence logistics to open-road trucking. By combining AI-powered autonomy with human oversight and modular, vehicle-agnostic hardware, we enable businesses and defence organizations to harness the full potential of automation, driving efficiency and safety.

FERNRIDE was founded in 2019 following 10 years of research at the Technical University of Munich and currently has over 150 employees. We are setting the standard for autonomous logistics and advancing Europe’s technological sovereignty by delivering the first-ever fully certified autonomous trucking system in Europe in 2025. 

Physical AI is the biggest transformational technology of our time. Backed by €75 million in venture funding from top-tier investors and trusted by blue chip customers, such as HHLA, Volkswagen, and DB Schenker, we are on a mission to build Europe’s leader in Physical AI, on track to lead the world in next-generation industrial automation.

Name: microagi
Description: microagi, founded in 2025, is a robotics deployment company. Its platform, Atlas, fine-tunes models on a customer’s own operations, drawing on microagi’s proprietary data corpus, and closes the gap between the robot that impresses in a demo and the robot that does reliable work on the line. Atlas is hardware- and model-agnostic: a neutral layerbetween a customer’s infrastructure and frontier AI models, designed to prevent lock-in to any single vendor. microagi is headquartered in Munich, with a research hub in Zurich and offices in London and New York.

Name: R3 Robotics
Description:
R3 Robotics is a European robotics company focused on the automated dismantling of electrified systems at industrial scale. Our mission is to unlock maximum value from end-of-life electric vehicle systems through safe, data-driven, and scalable automation. 

Founded in 2021, R3 Robotics pioneered robotic disassembly and diagnostics for EV batteries, establishing the technological foundation for broader automated dismantling across electrified systems. 

We operate a modular automated dismantling platform that combines robotics, vision systems, and software intelligence to support industrial-scale reuse, recycling, and remanufacturing across the electrification value chain.

Name: SAFELOG
Description: Since 1996, we have been passionately working on the development and intelligent linking of innovative logistics systems. Starting with our first patent for a pick-by-light solution, which we have been continuously developing for over 25 years now, we have established ourselves on the market with various products in the field of intralogistics. Our portfolio of mobile robots enables, for example, the customer-specific handling of complex transport and supply tasks both in shuttle operation and in production lines. We do not use a higher-level control center, but instead rely on agent-based control with swarm intelligence. This allows us to implement projects with just a few robots as well as with swarms of several hundred SAFELOG robots without incurring high costs for a control center or additional control software. Our solutions are used in production, distribution, and order picking in a wide range of industries, such as automotive, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering. As a software-based system provider, we can respond flexibly and quickly to customer-specific requests and implement them together with you.

Name: Circus Group
Description: The Circus Group (XETRA: CA1) is the leading AI robotics company, specialising in the translation of the fine art of cooking into full autonomy. On its mission to fuel humanity, Circus provides global access to balanced nutrition, for everyone, anytime. The company developed the world’s first commercially viable food production robot, Circus Autonomy One.

Name: German Bionic
Description: German Bionic is a European Physical AI pioneer that develops and manufactures AI-powered exosuits and other wearable technologies. It was the world’s first company to deliver connected exoskeletons for the workplace, applying self-learning and augmented artificial intelligence to support lifting movements and prevent poor posture, and thereby becoming an intelligent link between humans and machines. The German Bionic smart power suits and wearables protect the health of workers and markedly reduce the risk of accidents and injury to consequently improve work processes. In recognition of this innovative technology, which puts people back at the center of Industry 5.0, German Bionic has received numerous awards, including the CES “Best of Innovation” Award, the Health Tech Award, the Fast Company “Innovation by Design Award”, the German Entrepreneur Award, and a nomination for the prestigious Hermes Award at the Hannover Messe. Headquartered in Augsburg, Germany, German Bionic has offices across Europe and Asia.

Name: All3
Description:
All3 is a construction technology company that’s redefining how buildings are designed and built. By combining AI-powered design with robotic fabrication, All3 enables developers to deliver custom, sustainable buildings at the cost and speed of mass production.

At its core, All3 is about solving the construction industry’s biggest challenges - low productivity resulting in high costs, and environmental impact - by bringing the precision and productivity of advanced automation to the built environment.

In essence, All3 isn’t just a construction company - it’s a technology-driven enabler that empowers architects to design freely, developers to build more efficiently, and communities to access high-quality, sustainable housing.

Where traditional inspection requires teams of specialists and large supporting vessels offshore, BeeX drones operate entirely on their own. Our approach delivers industry-grade underwater data at a fraction of traditional costs and project schedules, consistent and repeatable across any environment.

With global deployments across complex underwater conditions, 14 years of proprietary subsea data, the largest fleet of operational underwater drones, and drone acquisition contracts with the Singapore Ministry of Defence, we're leading the most advanced end-to-end solution for underwater inspections, and the most scalable operating model in the industry.

Interested to learn more? Reach us at hello@beex.sg

Name: TUM Autonomous Vehicle Systems Lab
Description:
Welcome to the Autonomous Vehicle Systems (AVS) lab, where the future of intelligent transportation comes to life. At AVS, we are dedicated to advancing the field of autonomous vehicles through pioneering research and innovative education. Our lab explores the core aspects of autonomous systems, emphasizing the development of groundbreaking algorithms for dynamic trajectory planning, behavior prediction, adaptive control, and continuous learning.

Research and Development:
We are on a mission to create the next generation of autonomous vehicles. We are pushing the boundaries of what's possible with a wide range of applications, from conventional autonomous road vehicles like cars and trucks to specialized machines designed for challenging terrains and compact autonomous robots for service tasks. Our goal is to enhance the interaction between vehicles and their environment, ensuring efficient, safe, and reliable operations.

Trustworthy Autonomy:
In an era where safety and efficiency are paramount, our lab is on the cutting edge of creating trustworthy autonomous systems. We are on a mission to develop vehicles that can interact seamlessly with humans and other vehicles. By integrating adaptive dynamic path planning with behavior planners, our algorithms can navigate uncertainties in complex, multi-agent environments, paving the way for robust autonomous operations.

Applied Software Development:
At AVS, theory meets practice in our state-of-the-art simulation environments, where algorithms undergo rigorous testing in both 2D and 3D settings. They leverage detailed models of sensors, vehicle dynamics, and environmental interactions to mirror real-world conditions closely. This approach not only enhances our understanding of algorithm performance but also bridges the gap between simulated testing and real-world application.

Name: Security Robotics Development & Solutions GmbH
Description:
Security Robotics entwickelt autonome KI-, Robotik- und IoT-Lösungen für die Sicherheits-, Inspektions- und Präventionswelt von morgen. Als Full-Stack-Anbieter verbinden wir eigene Software, Hardware, Sensorik und künstliche Intelligenz zu einem integrierten Ökosystem, das Risiken frühzeitig erkennt, Prozesse optimiert und Ausfälle verhindert.

Mit Technologien wie unserer Orchestrierungsplattform ACUDA, eigenen KI-Modellen, multisensorischer Umweltanalyse und intelligenter IoT-Vernetzung schaffen wir skalierbare Lösungen für Industrie, Logistik, KRITIS, Infrastruktur und moderne Sicherheitswirtschaft. Unsere autonomen Systeme unterstützen nicht nur Sicherheitsaufgaben, sondern auch Inspektion, Instandhaltung und präventive Analysen.

Von Beratung, Konzeptentwicklung und Integration bis zu Schulung, Support und Betrieb begleiten wir unsere Kunden ganzheitlich. Security Robotics steht für resiliente, technologisch souveräne und zukunftsfähige Infrastrukturlösungen – Made in Germany.

Name: NEXT robotics
Description:
NEXT robotics mit Sitz in Zimmern ob Rottweil ist ein forschungsnahes Vertriebs- und Entwicklungsbüro, Systemhaus und Technologieanbieter für neuartige Robotertechnik. Der Ursprung des Unternehmens liegt im Jahr 1955. In 2003 folgte eine schrittweise Neuausrichtung auf die Leichtbaurobotik – mit dem Ziel den Roboter der menschlichen Arbeitswelt näher zu bringen.

Das Unternehmen steht heute für kollaborative stationäre und mobile Robotik, sowie modulare Präzisionsrobotik und Mikrotechnik. Beide Bereiche profitieren von der Einbindung künstlicher Intelligenz, um dem Roboter (Advanced Robotics) menschliche Fähigkeiten näher zu bringen, oder neue Prozesse erst zu ermöglichen.

NEXT robotics befasst sich kontinuierlich mit neuesten Entwicklungen in der Robotertechnik, ist Teil innovativer Forschungsprojekte. Themenfelder wie Technologietransfer, Standardisierung, Modularisierung und Marktentwicklung zählen ebenfalls dazu. Die Entwicklung neuer Denkansätze, modularer Konzepte ist Teil der Unternehmensphilosophie.

Die zunehmende Komplexität innovativer Technologien, wie der künstlichen Intelligenz, erfordert mehr Dialog, der über das eigens initiierte New Technology Network (NTn) angeboten wird. Die  Intention ist ein besseres Verständnis, mehr Raum für neue Lösungskonzepte, um technische Herausforderungen gemeinsam erfolgreich meistern zu können.

Name: EvoLogics GmbH
Description:
EvoLogics GmbH is a German-based high-tech enterprise. The company was founded in 2000 by a group of leading international scientists and R&D experts aimed to develop innovative key technologies for maritime and offshore industries through interdisciplinary cooperation between engineering and life sciences.

EvoLogics GmbH designs and manufactures underwater information and communication systems based on bionic concepts, combining cutting edge engineering with the best ideas found in nature. The advanced product features have become enabling technologies for deep water exploration and production. 

EvoLogics’ products offer highly reliable, flexible and cost-effective solutions for multiple underwater communication, positioning, navigation and monitoring applications. The team strives for innovation and invests its vast experience into developing, manufacturing and supporting  products that deliver an excellent performance and solve the most challenging tasks.

EvoLogics' developments are based on the patented S2C (Sweep Spread Carrier) technology - the most reliable acoustic telemetry available for subsea and offshore applications that provides an independent bidirectional data link along with acoustic positioning, broadcasting and full networking capabilities. The company’s solutions can simultaneously facilitate optimal operation and navigation of subsea robots. They enable retrieving information from various subsea sensors and other subsystems and allow to control complex processes by combining communication with high-accuracy positioning and multiple monitoring options.

S2C systems have been carefully designed for operations in harsh underwater environments and enhanced with special algorithms for signal processing and data management. The company’s extensive experience with sensor integration allows it to provide customers with turn-key solutions ranging from initial deployment up to recovering the equipment.

Name: RoboTUM
Description:
RoboTUM: Shaping the Future of Robotics in Europe 

At RoboTUM, we’re on a mission to make Munich the robotics hub of Germany and Europe.  Co-founded by passionate students from the Technical University of Munich (TUM), we’re bringing together talent, industry, and innovation to redefine what’s possible in the world of robotics.

Our initiative operates at the crossroads of technology and collaboration:

Whether you’re a student looking to make your mark, an academic driven by curiosity, or an industry leader seeking innovation, RoboTUM is the place to connect, create, and collaborate.

Name: Nature Robots
Description:
Nature Robots aims to support regenerative and ecological agriculture through AI and robotics in harmony with nature and humans.
Nature Robots develops autonomous robots for regenerative agriculture. Based on the specially designed and built long-term autonomous monitoring robot Lero, high-resolution three-dimensional plant maps of vegetables and other plant crops, as well as weeds, are created and migrated into a monitoring user interface for agronomists, farmers, and plant breeders. The AI and robotics systems allow for use in natural and arbitrary-structured environments, such as vegetable production, orcharding, and viticulture, as well as in agroforestry, forestry, photovoltaic, and agrophotovoltaic environments. Customer benefits range from the reduction of workload to an enhanced productivity of the agricultural system.
Nature Robots is a spin-off of the German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI) and was founded in January 2022 in Osnabrück.

Name: Devanthro - the Robody Company

Because robotics and AI aren't just transforming industries – they're changing how we work, live, and make decisions as a society. Robot Valley creates the space to reflect on this transformation together, drive it forward, and take responsibility for it.

Name: byte robotics GmbH
Description:
Automatic Generation of Optimal Paths

Robots are among the most flexible machine tools available today for industrial use. While conventional machine tools are usually highly specialised structures for individual application scenarios, industrial robots (with the right tool) can be used for an extremely wide range of application scenarios.

Focus
However, path generation during programming of industrial robot applications consumes a lot of time and the quality of the paths depends significantly on the experience of the offline programmer. The focus of byte robotics software "AuRora" is therefore the decoupling of path quality and individual skills by:

*    Automatic sequencing of workflows
*    Automatic path generation of collision-free infeed movements
*    Control-based multi-criteria optimization
*    Integration of our research results into industry-relevant offline programming


German/ Deutsch:

Automatische Generierung optimaler Pfade
Roboter gehören zu den flexibelsten Werkzeugmaschinen, die heutzutage für den industriellen Einsatz zur Verfügung stehen. Während herkömmliche Werkzeugmaschinen in der Regel hochspezialisierte Konstruktionen für einzelne Anwendungsszenarien darstellen, sind Industrieroboter für eine äußerst große Bandbreite an Einsatzszenarien nutzbar.

Fokus
Die Pfaderzeugung während der Programmierung von industriellen Roboteranwendungen verschlingt jedoch viel Zeit und die Qualität der Pfade hängt maßgeblich von der Erfahrung des Offline-Programmierers ab. Schwerpunkt von byte robotics ist die Software "Aurora" mit der Entkopplung von Pfadqualität und individuellen Fähigkeiten Einzelner durch:

*Automatische Sequenzierung von Arbeitsabläufen
*Automatische Pfadgenerierung von kollisionsfreien Zustellbewegungen
*Automatische Ausnutzung von Werkzeugfreiheitsgeraden
*Integration in bestehende Offline-Programmierungen

Name: Sensodrive GmbH
Description:
Sensodrive is a high-tech German company specialising in the development of torque sensors and robotic drives with integrated torque measurement and control. As a spin-off from the German Aerospace Centre (DLR), the company was a pioneer of human-robot collaboration with its patented torque sensors and is still a market leader in technology today. Sensodrive's expertise can now be found in almost all cobots worldwide. 

Sensodrive's innovative torque technologies not only set standards in industrial robotics, but also in medical technology, the automotive sector and force-feedback solutions. With the development of the sensitive, torque-controlled SensoJoint drive unit, the company is the only global provider of complete drive modules, that can be integrated into any sensitive robotics and force-feedback using Plug & Play. The company has been fully certified in all important safety standards from 2024. This enables any company to develop cobots and medical robots within a very short timeframe, skipping years of development and certification processes.

Description:

Name: Telekinesis
Description:
Telekinesis is building Europe’s leading Physical AI cloud platform, giving any robot, industrial, mobile, humanoid, quadruped, or drone, the ability to perceive, reason, and act with human-like intelligence.

Unlike traditional automation, Telekinesis empowers non-experts on the factory floor to deploy and teach robots in minutes—without writing a single line of code. Focused on automotive, aerospace, and metal manufacturing, the platform enables automation of tasks still performed manually today, particularly in end-of-line manufacturing such as assembly validation, labeling, cable harnessing, laser engraving, and final quality inspection.

At the heart of the system is a universal AI brain that adapts to any robot and task, delivering unmatched flexibility and rapid deployment. This is made possible by breakthrough Physical AI technologies such as Visual Robot Programming, where robots learn directly from video demonstrations; LLM Plan, which transforms natural language prompts into executable behavior; and AutoPlan, which autonomously generates motion plans for complex tasks. Together, these innovations turn robotics into an intuitive tool that anyone can use.

Telekinesis is a spin-off from the Intelligent Autonomous Systems Lab at TU Darmstadt, led by Prof. Jan Peters, a pioneer in robotics and machine learning. Backed by leading investors and industry veterans—including the former MDs of KUKA and Universal Robots (UR/WE)—Telekinesis is transforming two decades of academic innovation into real-world industrial impact.

We’re making robots usable—by anyone.

Name: DRZ - Deutsches Rettungsrobotik-Zentrum e.V.
Description:
Our vision is that helpful robotic systems in the air, at sea and on land will make the everyday lives of civil emergency response teams safer. This is because in particularly dangerous situations (earthquakes, CBRNe, etc.), robots and BOS drones can be deployed in such a way that human emergency services do not have to be put at additional risk.

To this end, rescue robotics must be researched, developed and learnt so that they can be deployed successfully. The DRZ e.V. is the world's largest network for rescue robotics! We bring together application, research and companies to work together on the real deployment of the future - with robotic support.

Researching rescue robotics...
...for us at the DRZ means participating in research projects as a fully-fledged partner. We have already done this several times at national and international level. But we are also happy to take on contract research. Just get in touch with us!

Developing rescue robotics...
...for us means offering companies our 2,800 square metre "Living Lab" with its diverse structures and possible uses. But for us it also means carrying out trials and tests on commission. We would be happy to prepare a customised offer.

Learning rescue robotics...
...for us means offering training courses for civil emergency response teams. This involves not only flying robots, but also ground robotics and water robotics. (Our courses are currently only available in German.)

Using rescue robotics...
...for us means subjecting innovative technology to the endurance test of real operations. Our "Robotics Task Force - under construction" has already been involved in several operations in co-operation with the Dortmund fire brigade (telecommunication train).

Name: efeuCampus Bruchsal GmbH, innovation centre for urban, autonomous logistics and transport
Description: efeuCampus Bruchsal GmbH intends to establish the lighthouse project efeuCampus (eco-friendly experimental urban logistics campus) on the site of the former Dragonerkaserne ("efeuQuartier") as part of the RegioWin research project "Innovation centre for autonomous urban freight logistics" funded by the state of Baden-Württemberg. This lighthouse project is to become a permanent source of inspiration for the business location Bruchsal for the development of solutions for last mile freight logistics and autonomous vehicle technology. In the efeuQuartier, a residential quarter of the future is to be created in the medium term as a "habitable laboratory", in which technologies for energy-efficient building and living in the spirit of the energy turnaround will be tested and presented. In this reference quarter, which is unique in Europe, goods of all kinds are to be moved with innovative vehicles, emission-free, generationally appropriate and driverless. The sustainable reduction of motorised delivery traffic on the so-called last mile is intended to reduce energy consumption and CO2 emissions and to decisively improve the quality of life in the neighbourhood. The experience gathered in the efeuCampus Innovation Centre is to be evaluated and published for a wide range of applications. For this communicative interface function internally and externally, the efeuAkademie was founded as a sub-project.

Name: Lab Automators
Description:
Lab Automators is a vibrant community originating in the Boston area dedicated to advancing the field of lab automation technology. We orchestrate premier  biotech events, happy hours and product launches, creating a platform for networking and discussion among professionals in the sector. Each event, whether a seasonal premiere or an episode showcasing automated lab builds, brings together a diverse group of vendors and practitioners tasked with envisioning the future of automated lab setups. By doing so, we not only promote the exploration of lab automation technology but also provide a space for engineers and scientists alike to connect face-to-face.

Our events are more than just a showcase of technology; they are a hub for meaningful dialogue. For instance, during our events, attendees have the chance to identify and discuss common pain points in lab automation, fostering a collaborative environment to tackle these issues. The discussion extends to the importance of data management in cloud environments, aiming to bridge the gap between data acquisition on the ground and data management in the cloud. The dream, as expressed by the community, is to make transitioning between these realms as easy as flipping a switch, with short implementation times. The enormous turnout at their events, as noted in one of their meetings at the Liberty Hotel in Cambridge, underscores the value and impact that Lab Automators is bringing to the scientific community in the regions our chapters are in.

Description:
Unsere Vision im Bereich der sozialen Robotik besteht darin, dass Mensch und Roboter gemeinsam in flexiblen Teams in allen Bereichen des täglichen Lebens zielführend zusammenarbeiten und neue Roboterapplikationen in kürzester Zeit realisiert werden können. Das Projekt FORSocialRobots soll daher in sechs relevanten Anwendungsfeldern robotischer Applikationen – Überwachung (A1), Logistik (A2), Produktion (A3), Service (A4), Seniorenheim (A5) und Demenzzentrum (A6) –  und in fünf wissenschaftlichen Teilprojekten – Architektur sozialer Fähigkeiten (TP1), sozial situative Kommunikation (TP2), sozial adaptive und proaktive Interaktion (TP3), Simulation und Validierung sozial kognitiver Roboter im Digitalen Zwilling (TP4) und Mensch-Roboter-Interaktion im Arbeitskontext (TP5) – einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Verbesserung der sozialen Fähigkeiten von Robotern leisten, damit deren Wirksamkeit und Akzeptanz bei den potenziellen Nutzern steigern sowie völlig neue technische Entwicklungen unterstützen.

Das Projektvorhaben ist auf drei Jahre angelegt. Das Projektkonsortium besteht aus Forschungseinrichtungen, Einrichtungen der angewandten Forschung, Unternehmen und Anwendern, welche gemeinsam sowohl das Know-how besitzen, Roboter physisch und softwareseitig zu erforschen als auch geeignete Anwendungsfälle exemplarisch umzusetzen und dabei ethische, rechtliche und soziale Implikationen (ELSI) zu beachten. 

Beteiligte Forschungsinstitute:
- Lehrstuhl für Fertigungsautomatisierung und Produktionssystematik (FAPS) der Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU)
- Lehrstuhl für Psychologie im Arbeitsleben (PiA) der FAU
- Fraunhofer IIS
- Fraunhofer IGCV

Name: Robotic Summit
Description:
Veranstaltung für Anwendungsbezogene medizinische Robotik mit dem Ziel, Wissen zu vermitteln und die Vernetzung von Medizin und Industrie zu fördern.

Zielsetzung der Veranstaltung:
1. Vernetzung: Plattform für den branchenübergreifenden Austausch zwischen Medizin und Industrie.
2. Wissensvermittlung: Aufklärung über Innovationen durch Fachvorträge, Panels und Live-Demos.
3. Neuheiten: Präsentation der neuesten Entwicklungen in der medizinischen Robotik.
4. Langfristige Vision: Etablierung als führendes Forum für Medical Robotics, alle zwei Jahre mit Branchenführern und Visionären.

Der Robotic Summit 2025 (RS25) bringt Expertinnen und Experten aus Medizin und Industrie zusammen, um die Potenziale der anwendungsbezogenen medizinischen Robotik zu präsentieren und zu vernetzen.
Ursprünglich als kleines Symposium des Brüderkrankenhauses Paderborn gestartet, entwickelt sich der PRS zu einer führenden Plattform, die den Austausch über Innovationen und Einsatzmöglichkeiten robotischer Systeme in der Medizin fördert.
Der Hauptfokus der Veranstaltung liegt auf der Aufklärung über Innovationen in der medizinischen Robotik und deren praktischen Nutzen für Patienten sowie für die Effizienz und Wirtschaftlichkeit von Krankenhäusern. Ergänzend werden auch Lösungen für die Pflege und angrenzende Bereiche vorgestellt, um ein ganzheitliches Bild moderner Robotik im Gesundheitswesen zu bieten.

Name: TUC Drillbotics
Description:
We are an interdisciplinary and international team of students at Clausthal University of Technology and are involved in the Drillbotics team to participate in the international Drillbotics competition. Our team is working on a fully automated, scaled directional drilling rig under the supervision of senior researchers and scientists from the Department of Deep Drilling Technology at the Institute of Subsurface Energy Systems at Clausthal University of Technology.

Name: racontec GmbH
Description:
Gehirn und Herz einer jeden Roboterapplikation sind die Steuerungssysteme und das Steuerungskonzept.

Entscheidend für einen sicheren, langfristigen und wirtschaftlichen Betrieb ist hierbei die optimale Verbindung aus:

- standardisierten, nachhaltig verfügbaren Steuerungskomponenten und –Modulen namhafter Hersteller sowie

- individuell angepasster, im Zweifel hoch komplexer Funktionalität für Roboter und Sondermaschinen.

Die Steuerungsphilosophie von racontec basiert auf umfangreicher Erfahrung im professionellen Umgang insbesondere mit Technologien aus dem Hause SIEMENS in Verbindung mit eigenem langjährigem Know-how bei der Entwicklung von Roboter- und Maschinensteuerungen.
